description: This file defines the ProfilerNodeVisitor class in the Twig templating engine, implementing profiling for different node types during template rendering.

classes.name: ProfilerNodeVisitor
classes.description: Implements a node visitor for profiling Twig templates, inserting profiling nodes where appropriate.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ProfilerNodeVisitor with an extension name, generating a unique variable name for profiling.

methods.name: enterNode
methods.description: Returns the node unchanged; can be extended to add profiling at node entry.

methods.name: leaveNode
methods.description: Wraps nodes with profiling start/end nodes for ModuleNode, BlockNode, and MacroNode types.

methods.name: getPriority
methods.description: Returns the priority of this node visitor, used to determine execution order.
